name: Avatar: Seven Havens
s: In a world shattered by a devastating cataclysm, a young Earthbender discovers she's the new Avatar after Korra. But in this dangerous era, that title marks her as humanity's destroyer, not its savior. Hunted by both human and spirit enemies, she and her long-lost twin must uncover their mysterious origins and save the Seven Havens before civilization's last strongholds collapse.

paragraphs.text: Avatar: Seven Havens is an American animated fantasy action television series created by Michael Dante DiMartino and Bryan Konietzko for Paramount+. It serves as a sequel series to Avatar: The Last Airbender (2005–2008) and The Legend of Korra (2012–2014). It follows Avatar Pavi, as she and her long-lost twin sister Avatar Nisha, the reincarnations of Korra, uncover their mysterious origins and protect the Seven Havens—cities that stand as last bastions of civilization after a global cataclysm.

The principal voice cast includes Saheli Khan as Avatar Pavi, alongside Aishu Devan, Akshay Khanna, Major Curda, Sakina Jaffrey, Darren Barnet, Dianne Doan, and Dee Bradley Baker. Creatives from both The Last Airbender and The Legend of Korra returned, including Jeremy Zuckerman creating original music and Ethan Spaulding, who was a story artist and director on both shows, executive producing. The series is produced by Nickelodeon Animation and Avatar Studios, and La Chouette Compagnie provides animation.

The first season of Avatar: Seven Havens, titled Book 1: Survival, premiered on October 9, 2026, on Paramount+, with the concurrent release of its first three episodes. The other ten episodes are being released weekly in batches of three to four episodes through October 30. It received acclaim from critics, who complimented the characters, storytelling, and the visual style. Three additional seasons have also been ordered.

225 years after Avatar Korra's time, the world is mostly an inhospitable place after a cataclysm attributed to Korra terraforms the world into the perennially calamitous Harshlands, except the eponymous Seven Havens: isolated hubs of civilization created in the wake of the disaster to save humanity. In Ellora, one of the havens, a timid 9-year-old orphan, Pavi, discovers that she is the next Avatar. Hunted by both human and spirit enemies, and viewed by the world as an annihilator instead of a savior, she and her long-lost twin sister, Avatar Nisha, must uncover their strange shared backstory and save the Seven Havens from looming threats.

On the review aggregator website Rotten Tomatoes, the series holds an approval rating of 100%, based on 21 reviews, with an average of rated reviews of 7.9/10. The website's critics consensus reads, "Seven Havens embarks on a new saga with inspired storytelling, a vibrant sense of style, and remarkable characters that ultimately usher in a positive new era for Avatar." Metacritic, which uses a weighted average, assigned a score of 80 out of 100 based on 11 critics, indicating "generally favorable" reviews.
